P R O F E S S I O N A L S U M M A R Y

Senior Business Analyst and Loan IQ Functional Consultant with 17+ years of progressive experience in Corporate Banking, Syndicated Lending, Investment Banking, and Capital Markets. Deep hands-on expertise in FINASTRA Fusion Loan IQ — covering the full loan lifecycle from Deal Setup and Facility Configuration to Drawdowns, Fee Processing, Interest Accrual, and Statutory Regulatory Reporting. Proven delivery record across global tier-1 institutions including ING Bank Netherlands, BNP Paribas, Credit Suisse, and BNY Mellon. Skilled in bridging business and technology through rigorous requirements gathering, end-to-end SDLC delivery, Agile/Scrum execution, and leading cross-functional offshore BA teams. Strong additional background in Market Risk, Liquidity Risk, and Regulatory Reporting (LCR, NSFR, COREP, FINREP, SiFi3).

F I N A S T R A L O A N I Q — F U N C T I O N A L E X P E R T I S E

Core Loan IQ Modules & Functional Knowledge

Deal Setup & Configuration — Bilateral and Syndicated deal structures, multi-lender arrangements, agent and non-agent roles, deal amendment workflows, and deal-level accounting setup.

Facility Management — Revolving Credit Facilities (RCF), Term Loans (TL/TLA/TLB), Sub-limits, Swinglines, Letter of Credit (LC) facilities, facility fee configuration, and maturity management.

Outstandings & Drawdowns — Loan booking, drawdown processing, repayment scheduling, rollover management, prepayments, and maturity extensions across multi-currency portfolios.

Covers & Risk Participations — Funded and unfunded risk participation setup, cover management for syndicated and bilateral exposure, and counterparty risk tracking.

Fee Processing — Commitment fees, agency fees, upfront fees, utilisation fees, waiver fees, amendment



fees — accrual and settlement workflows in Loan IQ. Interest Accrual & Rate Setting — SOFR, EURIBOR, SONIA, LIBOR transition handling, base rate and spread configuration, interest period management, non-accrual processing, and rate reset workflows.

Loan Amendments & Restructuring — Covenant waiver processing, facility extension, repricing, lender transfers, and syndication changes.

Loan IQ Regulatory & Statutory Reporting — LCR, NSFR, SiFi3, COREP, FINREP reporting configured and validated via GFRS (Global Financial Reporting System) integration with Loan IQ data.

SWIFT & Payments Integration — MT103, MT202 payment message processing, agent notification handling, nostro reconciliation, and settlement workflows.

Data Architecture & SQL — Deep understanding of Loan IQ database schema, Oracle-SQL based GFRS architecture, data flow from Loan IQ to downstream reporting systems.

Testing & Release Management — BRD, FRD, FSD authoring; SIT, UAT, and regression testing per Loan IQ release cycle; defect triage and stakeholder sign-off facilitation.

Loan IQ Upgrades & Releases — Major release and patch release delivery, regression testing across functional modules, and change impact assessment.

FINASTRA Fusion Loan IQ — Commercial Lending BA

Outstandings & Drawdown Management: Define and validate business requirements for loan drawdown processing, repayment schedules, rollovers, prepayments, and maturity extensions across multi-currency, multi-branch portfolios on Loan IQ.

Statutory & Regulatory Reporting — GFRS / LCR / NSFR / COREP / FINREP

Lead business analysis for ING Bank's statutory and regulatory reporting tribe, covering local and head-office submissions across LCR, NSFR, SiFi3, COREP, FINREP, and Liquidity reporting requirements governed by EBA/ECB regulatory frameworks.

Manage end-to-end change delivery on GFRS (Global Financial Reporting System) — ING's Oracle-SQL based regulatory reporting platform — analysing how Loan IQ data flows into GFRS and ensuring regulatory calculations and submissions are accurate and complete.

Perform regression testing every GFRS release cycle, validating regulatory report outputs against expected results and ensuring zero-defect production deployment for mandatory regulatory submissions.

Conduct root-cause analysis on production regulatory reporting issues, identifying data discrepancies between Loan IQ source data and downstream GFRS reporting outputs, and delivering structured fix recommendations to IT and operations teams.

Manage Quarterly Business Review (QBR) sessions with ING business stakeholders, translating lending and regulatory change requests into prioritised delivery roadmaps in collaboration with the Scrum Master and development leads.

Collaborate with IT architecture, development, and testing teams to ensure Loan IQ and GFRS system changes are correctly designed, tested, and deployed, with full traceability from business requirement to UAT sign-off.

Provide L3 production support for Loan IQ and GFRS issues, performing in-depth Oracle SQL analysis to identify and resolve data integrity and processing failures.
